SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, TO_CHAR(KEY_3) AS LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3,KEY_4
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KOLN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO, KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, NVL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KII_PO_KEP_RCV_V, KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND KEY_3 = LEGACY_GR_NO(+) AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_GR_SEQ(+) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ
UPDATE KII_PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN'
